approval_ref: The controlled Reference evaluation exposed repeated settled QA V3 contract failures across both text and vision routes before any result could be saved.
notes: Mirror every validator-only nested QA V2 invariant in the QA V3 system prompt instead of weakening local evidence validation.
Keep exact quote, citation scope, number support, local arithmetic and complete-answer rules unchanged.
Persist only one safe validator category for future rejected decisions; never retain invalid provider output or document text.
Do not retry or alter the existing settled S1/S2 calls.
Full validation passed: 1,496 Python tests, 24 localization tests, 11 deployment tests, 147 synchronized requirements, 21 schemas and a 605-file bundle manifest.
title: Align QA V3 prompt with its answer validator
objective: Make the QA V3 model-visible contract match the unchanged local nested answer validator and retain a safe machine-readable category for future rejected output without storing provider text.
